turn_history.text: To calculate the volume of a cuboid, you need to multiply the dimensions together, not add them. turn_history.text: Um, I think I added them up... so I did 30 minus 2 minus 3 and got 25? But you said I need to multiply instead, so should I do 2 times 3 first and then... do something with the 30?
